workload.note: Missed time late in season due to PCL knee injury suffered vs. Carolina (Sunday game reported 2025-11-17); ruled week-to-week, missed at least Week 12 vs. New Orleans.

contract.note: Signed 4-year, $141M extension (up to $150M with incentives), $100M guaranteed, through the 2030 season.

scheme.note: New HC Kevin Stefanski hired for 2026 (per multiple Falcons.com/SI sources); Stefanski confirmed Tommy Rees will call offensive plays. Falcons' offense also features RB Bijan Robinson (19.8% target share) and TE Kyle Pitts (22.7% target share) as central pieces per AJC (2026-07-21), which could cap London's target ceiling somewhat.

competition.name: Zachariah Branch
competition.note: Drew praise: 'He's a dog. He's a great human being and a great player as well' — Branch on London; Tua Tagovailoa (context: minicamp) called Branch 'Dude's fast. Dude can play. Very shifty.'

notes: GM Ian Cunningham on London (extension announcement): 'Drake London represents exactly what we're building here. His work ethic, competitive drive, and team-first mindset is refreshing to witness.'

Bijan Robinson on London's extension: 'He's an incredible football player and another guy that's just going to keep getting better' / 'I was so happy for him. He deserves it. He deserves everything that he gets.'
London quote on re-signing: 'I couldn't be happier to be here in Atlanta and staying here, even though it's been different coaches, different teammates.'
Falcons WR room has been 'rebuilt' around London per AJC headline (2026-07-21).

injury.status: Not on ATL Week 3 injury report [news 2026-09-21]

camp.quote: You never know, Drake could come back tomorrow and feel a lot better, but we'll get a feel for how that goes and he'll be a week-to-week guy.
Ultra cautious approach to London's condition; London could have participated but was held out as precaution.
camp.who: Kevin Stefanski, Falcons HC (paraphrased by NBC Sports PFT)

camp.quote: I want to live on for as long as I can so that shows that I am taking the right steps, the right direction.
